draftyak.entities.DraftAuthor.description: Who wrote a revision: the owner (a user id), the hub's AI (an AI run id), an agent (a grant or agent token id) or a plugin (a plugin instance id).

draftyak.entities.EmailAddress.description: An address as the hub normalizes it: a dot-atom local part as given, without spaces, quotes or invisible characters, and a lower-case DNS domain with IDN labels as A-labels.

draftyak.normalized-change.ProviderId.description: A provider's own id, opaque to the hub: visible ASCII, no spaces.

draftyak.normalized-change.ChatChannelTy.description: A direct message, a group direct message, or a public or private channel.

draftyak.flags.Flag.description: A flag on a draft revision: its code, the code's severity, and an optional detail (1 to 1,000 Unicode scalar values) that the composer and the approval window show as data.

draftyak.entities.OutboxState.description: An outbox item's state. APPROVED, SCHEDULED, SENDING, RETRY_WAIT and UNKNOWN are live: while a draft has a live item, it is locked.

draftyak.entities.StateReason.description: Why an item needs approval again; the UI labels it from this, as Missed.

draftyak.pairing.DisplayName.description: A display name: 1 to 64 code points under the rules of spec/pairing-v1.md section 2: no hidden code point, no blank first or last, and at least one code point that is neither a blank nor a joiner. JSON Schema can't state the rules, only the length.

draftyak.entities.PublicKeySpki.description: A P-256 public key as canonical base64url of its 91-byte SPKI DER, uncompressed point.

draftyak.entities.DeviceCapabilities.description: A device's capabilities, each once. A host:* capability is exclusive: a device that holds one holds nothing else.
